accountDescription: Sign in to continue to Patternly, or create an account if you do not have one yet.
welcomeTitle: Practice the patterns behind technical interviews and certifications
welcomeDescription: Build confidence through focused sessions, useful review, and clear next steps.
signInCredentialsError: We couldn't sign you in with those details.
unavailableDescription: Sign-in is unavailable right now. You can continue without an account.
alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
recoveryDescription: Enter your email address to request a password reset link.
recoveryCodeDescription: Enter a recovery code you saved for your account.
recoveryAcceptedDescription: If an account uses this address, we’ll send a password reset link. Check your inbox and spam folder.
resetPasswordCompleteDescription: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password to continue.
verificationDescription: Open the verification link sent to your email, then return here and check again.
signOutPendingDescription: We couldn’t finish signing you out. Connect to the internet and try again.
deleteAccountDescription: This permanently deletes your Patternly account and its saved progress, including account data on this device. Your store subscriptions and Apple or Google account are managed separately.
publicDeletionLinkUnavailable: You can’t open the account deletion page here.
publicDeletionLinkInvalid: The account deletion page is unavailable here.
publicDeletionLinkOpenFailed: Try opening the account deletion page again later.
deletionPendingDescription: Your account deletion is not finished. Try again to complete it.
localCleanupPendingDescription: Your account was deleted, but some of its data still needs to be removed from this device. Try again to finish.
remoteDeletionPending: We couldn’t confirm that your account was deleted. Try again.
localCleanupFailure: Some account data could not be removed from this device. Try again to finish.
sessionRevocationPending: We couldn’t finish signing you out. Try again when you’re connected.
reauthenticationRequired: Enter your password again to confirm this action.
recoveryCodesDescription: Save these 10 codes somewhere safe. You’ll only see this set once. Each code can be used once to regain access to your account.
accountReadyDescription: Review your saved progress and recovery options.
adoptionPreviewDescription: Review what will stay on this device, be added to your account, or be restored. Nothing changes until you confirm.
syncCompleteDescription: Your saved progress is up to date. Sessions in progress stay on this device.
pendingDescription: Your changes are saved on this device. Connect to the internet and try again to save them to your account.
conflictDescription: Some progress differs between this device and your account. Choose which version to keep before trying again.
dataFailureDescription: We couldn’t load your account progress. Your saved progress is still on this device.
activeSessionBlocked: Finish or leave your current session before combining progress.
journalBlocked: Resume the interrupted activity before combining progress.
pendingSyncRequiresNetwork: Sync pending changes before signing out.
journalRecoveryFailure: Resume the interrupted activity before signing out.
localDeletionFailure: Local account data could not be cleared. You remain signed in.
remoteFailure: The account service did not confirm this operation.
account_revision_conflict: The account changed on another device. Review the new preview.
version_conflict: A record changed on another device. Review the new preview.
adoption_conflict: Some records need an explicit choice.
active_session_sync_deferred: Sync waits until the active session is finished.
journal_recovery_required: Resume the interrupted activity before saving progress to your account.
account_data_unavailable: Account data is unavailable right now.
backendUnavailableDescription: We couldn’t connect to your Patternly account. Try again in a moment.
revokedSessionDescription: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign out, then sign in again to continue.
resetPasswordDescription: Use a new password you have not used for this account before.
termsRequired: Agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account.
termsUnavailable: You can’t open these documents here.
weakPassword: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
duplicate: This provider is already linked or the credential is already in use.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
offline: You appear to be offline. Try again when connected.
expiredAction: This link has expired. Request a new one.
providerUnavailable: This sign-in option is unavailable right now.
invalidCredential: We couldn’t verify your sign-in details.
invalidRecoveryCode: That recovery code is not valid. Check it and try again, or use email recovery.
recoveryCodeUsed: That recovery code has already been used. Try another code or use email recovery.
unverifiedIdentity: Verify your email before signing in.
